d: One of America's most notorious bank robbers vanished, but what happened to the fortune he left behind? In this episode of Expedition Unknown, Josh Gates, the explorer known for investigating the world's greatest mysteries, follows historical clues across the American Midwest in search of John Dillinger's missing loot. From exploring the childhood home of Public Enemy Number One to diving into a freezing lake at a remote Wisconsin lodge, Josh takes on a mystery rooted in America's criminal history.
